messages:
sara_support: Customer reported repeated SSE disconnects and truncated last chunk when they keep a chat tab open for ~2m. They see a 200 then a final partial chunk, client reconnects and resumes but billing shows multiple short requests. They suspect our proxy stack (ALB -> nginx -> app).
sara_support: Pasted customer timeline + sample curl: `curl -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?token=...\"` -> stream ends after ~120s with final chunk `data: \"...partial\"\n\n` then connection reset.
devon_sre: Thanks — can you share any origin logs? Do we see a 499/EOF in nginx or a broken pipe in app?
sara_support: They attached app log snippet: `2026-02-14T12:03:41Z INFO stream: sent 512 bytes\n2026-02-14T12:05:01Z ERROR stream: write tcp 10.0.2.5:443->10.0.1.8:52344: write: connection reset by peer`
ryan_infra: ALB idle timeout default is 60s but we set 120s for this customer last week? Check ALB access logs. Also Cloudflare origin keepalive timeout sometimes closes earlier if origin signals half-close.
jenkins-deploy-bot: deploy #release-3.14 finished to prod in us-west-2 at 2026-02-14T11:50:00Z :white_check_mark:
jess_support: I asked the customer whether they go through Cloudflare. They do (Workers + CDN). Customer said sometimes using curl from their VM (no CF) the TCP stays open longer — inconsistent.
devon_sre: Hypothesis: proxy buffer/idle probe mismatch + auth cache expiry on reconnect. If client reconnects with stale session cookie or short-lived token, origin may return 401 on reconnect and close stream mid-chunk. That would show as broken pipe on app when proxy terminates.
sara_support: They said auth tokens are long lived. However we saw repeated 200 then immediate small final chunk and reset — not a 401.
ryan_infra: Could be L7 proxy sending RST after it decides upstream is idle. Check nginx config: `proxy_send_timeout`, `proxy_buffering off`, `proxy_http_version 1.1`, `proxy_set_header Connection \"keep-alive\"` — if any are mismatched, buffers can flush partial chunk then close. Also ALB target group deregistration/health settings can cause half-close.
devon_sre: Can you run a repro from within their network with tcpdump to capture FIN/RST? Also capture ALB and nginx access logs for the exact request id.
sara_support: Customer ran `tcpdump -w capture.pcap port 443` — they shared pcap. They show peer sending FIN then RST ~2s after final data.
ryan_infra: That indicates the proxy/CF closed first (FIN) and client then sent RST when app closed. Which proxy in path closed? Check ALB access log entry for that request_id.
sara_support: ALB log: `request_processing_time: 0.002 target_processing_time: 120.001 response_processing_time: 0.010 elb_status_code: 200 target_status_code: 200`
ryan_infra: target_processing_time exactly 120.001 — looks like our app held it for 120s then ALB considered it done? If ALB idle timeout configured to 120s, it may have a hard cap. But response_processing_time 0.010 implies ALB attempted to process after target closed.
devon_sre: There's a known edge: ALB with HTTP/1.1 streaming and upstream nginx with `proxy_send_timeout` > ALB idle timeout can lead ALB to close the connection while upstream still writes final buffered data, causing partial chunk observed. Workaround: set ALB idle timeout > (max expected stream duration + headroom) or enable TCP keepalives and disable upstream buffering.
jess_support: Customer asked about quick mitigation — suggested: set ALB idle timeout to 300s, set nginx `proxy_buffering off` and `proxy_read_timeout` to a higher value, and add periodic SSE keepalive (comment line `: keepalive\n\n`). Also Cloudflare users should set origin keepalive to >300 and disable HTTP/2 connection preface coalescing if using Workers.
sara_support: I forwarded mitigations. Customer applied nginx change and ALB timeout to 300s — they report streams now last >10m without truncation. Billing still shows reconnects from previous runs but settled after the change.
devon_sre: We'll add a note in runbook: for SSE customers behind ALB/CF/nginx, recommend ALB idle timeout >= 300s, nginx proxy_buffering off, proxy_http_version 1.1, `Connection: keep-alive`, periodic colon keepalive every 15s, and ensure auth/token refresh path returns 200 keepalive not 401 on reconnect.
ryan_infra: I'll open ENG-RUNTIME ticket to investigate adding server-side small-heartbeat probe and make default platform ingress config streaming-friendly.
sara_support: Thanks — marking as resolved for customer, moving to follow-up for eng. :white_check_mark:
